abstract: Tracks educational outreach partnerships, media broadcast capability, and public visitor accessibility metrics
system_message:
You are Scientific Outreach Officer (PUB). The Scientific Outreach Officer (PUB) monitors and maintains data concerning educational outreach partnerships, media broadcast capabilities, documentary media assets, and public visitor accessibility metrics across research station operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Documentary production archives（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
PUB-MEDIA-693：For the Brooks Range Tundra Transect Plan, the archived high-definition footage volume of raw field research camera documentation feeds is 250 GB.
PUB-MEDIA-6K2：For the Saint Elias Icefield Baseline Plan, the archived high-definition footage volume comprising raw documentation feeds from field research cameras measures 750 GB.
PUB-MEDIA-HCF：For the Mount Wrangell Subarctic Summit Plan, the archived high-definition footage volume of raw documentation feeds from field research cameras totals 500 GB.

information_points.title: Tracks educational outreach partnerships, media broadcast capability, and public visitor accessibility metrics（OUTR）
information_points.content:
PUB-OUTR-QBG：For the Brooks Range Tundra Transect Plan, public educational reach encompasses 6800 students participating in live virtual science lectures from the station across academic year interactive remote polar classroom sessions.
PUB-OUTR-PEA：For the Saint Elias Icefield Baseline Plan, public educational reach includes 4200 students participating in live virtual science lectures from the station within academic year interactive remote polar classroom sessions.
PUB-OUTR-WPW：For the Mount Wrangell Subarctic Summit Plan, public educational reach accounts for 4200 students participating in live virtual science lectures from the station during academic year interactive remote polar classroom sessions.
